transcripts

01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above
03. Please specify the field of study in which you earned your degree(s).

04. How many years of professional experience do you possess in accounting, financial analysis, or auditing? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

05. How many years of professional experience do you possess performing general ledger analysis and preparing or interpreting financial statements? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years
06. Do you currently possess an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license? Options: No | Yes

07. Which of the following types of accounting experience do you possess? (Select all that apply.) Options: Governmental or public-sector accounting | Fund accounting | Higher education or community college accounting | Nonprofit accounting | Private-sector corporate accounting | None of the above

08. Describe your experience performing complex reconciliations and account analyses. In your response, please include: a. The types of accounts you reconciled, including any cash or bank accounts b. The complexity and volume of the accounts or transactions involved c. The methods you used to identify discrepancies or unusual activity d. Your responsibility for researching and resolving discrepancies e. Your level of independence in completing, reviewing, and resolving issues identified through the reconciliation process If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

09. Describe your experience preparing complex journal entries and making accounting corrections or adjustments. In your response, please include: a. The types of journal entries you prepared b. The circumstances that required the entries c. How you determined the appropriate accounts, debits, and credits d. The supporting documentation or research you used e. Your responsibility for ensuring the entries were accurate and properly supported If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

10. Which of the following accounting standards, regulations, or compliance areas have you applied in your professional work? (Select all that apply.) Options: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) | Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) standards | California Community College Budget and Accounting Manual (BAM) | Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS) | Federal fiscal or grant compliance requirements | State or local governmental accounting requirements | Internal control standards or procedures | None of the above

11. Describe your experience applying governmental accounting standards, regulations, or accounting guidance. In your response, please include: a. Your experience applying GASB standards or other governmental accounting requirements b. The accounting manuals, regulatory guidance, policies, or other authoritative resources you have used c. The types of accounting or financial issues for which you consulted or applied these resources d. Your level of responsibility for researching, interpreting, and applying the guidance e. Any experience recommending or implementing changes to accounting procedures or practices based on your research If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

12. Which of the following auditing activities have you performed? (Select all that apply.) Options: Preparing schedules and documentation for external auditors | Coordinating requests from external auditors | Performing internal or operational audits | Reviewing transactions for compliance with policies or regulations | Evaluating internal controls | Identifying control weaknesses and recommending corrective action | Following up on audit findings or corrective actions | None of the above

13. Describe your experience with financial or operational audits and internal controls. In your response, please include: a. Your role in internal or external audit activities b. The types of transactions, accounts, or processes reviewed c. Your experience evaluating compliance with applicable requirements and/or the effectiveness of internal controls d. Any discrepancies, control weaknesses, or findings you identified e. Any recommendations or corrective actions you developed or implemented If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

14. Which of the following systems or technology functions have you used in a professional accounting environment? (Select all that apply.) Options: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or financial accounting system | Advanced spreadsheet functions such as pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, or data analysis tools | Financial reporting software | Database or query tools used to extract or analyze financial data | Electronic audit or reconciliation tools | Testing or implementing financial system upgrades | Assisting with development of specifications or requirements for financial systems | None of the above

15. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (Located in Camarillo) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

16. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full-time Job | Part-time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work

17. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.

Any combination equivalent to: Education: A bachelor's degree from a recognized accredited college or university in accounting, business administration with significant course work in accounting, or a related field. Experience: Four (4) years of professional experience in accounting, financial analyses, or auditing with significant responsibility with general ledger analyses and financial statement preparation and interpretation. A Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license is desirable.

Perform complex and technical account analyses. E Maintain account detail, either individually or through the work of others. E Prepare complex and technical journal entries to record or correct transactions. E Maintain the District's Chart of Accounts in compliance with the California Community College Budget and Accounting Manual, and ensure the appropriate classification and recording of financial transactions; recommend changes in procedures when appropriate. E Prepare and interpret interim and annual financial statements and reports including the District's Consolidated Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A). E Gather, review, and analyze data pertinent to compliance of fiscal procedures with applicable statutes, regulations, and internal control standards. E Coordinate monthly and fiscal year-end schedules and associated deadlines for accounting activity. E Ensure financial reports accurately reflect the District's financial position monthly and at fiscal year-end. E Ensure financial records are maintained in compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB), and recommend changes in procedures when appropriate. E Perform operational or financial audits as required to analyze financial activity and ensure appropriate internal controls . E Coordinate the preparation of the annual external financial and compliance audit. E Develop procedures and train staff in appropriate compliance and in techniques of analysis and reconciliation.
